i1.speaker: iro
i1.text: Sit down, child. You walk like someone carrying too many lights.

i2.speaker: iro
i2.text: Well? What do you want from an old woman?

choices.text: Do you know where this world's key is?

i_who.speaker: iro
i_who.text: Just someone who has lived on the edge of a great many pages.

i_key.speaker: iro
i_key.text: I do. And I'll give it to you, because you still have light enough to see by. Promise me you'll use it to go somewhere he isn't.

i_refuse.speaker: iro
i_refuse.text: Hm. Your light's too low to see by, child. You'd only carry it back to him. Find it yourself - there's a shrine past the north turnstiles, where the ghouls nest. Maybe you'll find yourself in there too.

i_end.speaker: iro
i_end.text: Good. Now go meet him. Be gentle - he's you. And if my granddaughter asks you for a favour, do it. She sees further than I do.

page.speaker: iro
page.text: You read it, didn't you. Then you know what your master wears under that mask.

page2.speaker: iro
page2.text: Give it back to her anyway. Children should hold their own endings. Even the frightening ones.

after.speaker: iro
after.text: Go on. The brush is in your hand now.

post.speaker: iro
post.text: So you met him. And you're still standing, and still you. Good. The rest is just ink, child - and ink can be drawn over.
